title: Used ai to upscale my pixel art.
author: Healthy-Rent-5133
selftext: players often commented how my pixel art looked atrocious, so I added an optional AI generated HD remaster skin pack to my game Turn Based Boxing.

comments.author: umhassy
comments.body: Is this a battle brothers rip off?

replies.author: Healthy-Rent-5133
replies.body:
I'm very open that this is heavily inspired by battle brothers! I love battle brothers and it's my favorite game, I also am a huge boxing fan. 

I wanted to capture the build a bro side of battle brothers but with a gym of boxers and boxing perks / techniques etc. 

I asked the AI to make the remaster look like battle brothers.

comments.author: DSG_Mycoscopic
comments.body: Oh, that's disappointing. I like this game the last time I saw it and was happy to see a Battle Brothers-like in the world, but this feels kind of gross
